commands.review_summary:
The PR changes NodeExecutionEnv file metadata to derive FileInfo.name with Windows-aware basename splitting and adds a focused regression test.

PR surface: Source +6, Tests +48. Total +54 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main's fileInfoFromStats trims and splits only '/', so a Windows backslash path can retain parent directories despite the FileInfo.name basename contract. I did not run a before-fix Windows repro in this read-only review, but the path is clear from source.

target.title: fix(agent-core): keep file info basename on Windows paths
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users inspecting files through the agent harness on Windows would see `FileInfo.name` include parent directories when the addressed path used Windows separators.

## Why This Change Was Made

`NodeExecutionEnv` now derives file metadata names with platform-appropriate separators at the shared `fileInfoFromStats` boundary used by `fileInfo()` and `listDir()`. The fix stays local to agent-core file metadata and avoids changing POSIX handling, where backslashes can be valid filename characters.

## User Impact

Windows harness file metadata now reports stable basename-only names, so callers can display or compare file entries without carrying the full parent path in `name`.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: Windows-style addressed paths now produce basename-only `FileInfo.name` values through `NodeExecutionEnv.fileInfo()`.
- Current-head focused test at `5c6fcd827a4220274f446a6411b1bda2f49685b8`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/agent-core/src/harness/env/nodejs.test.ts` passed on this PR branch.
- Real Windows runtime proof at `5c6fcd827a4220274f446a6411b1bda2f49685b8`: a Node runtime command created a temporary file, called `NodeExecutionEnv.fileInfo()` on its Windows addressed path, redacted the repo prefix, and removed the file. It produced:

```json
{
  "platform": "win32",
  "inputPath": "<repo>\\.agents\\tmp-fileinfo-proof-1783603891638.txt",
  "expectedName": "tmp-fileinfo-proof-1783603891638.txt",
  "result": {
    "ok": true,
    "value": {
      "name": "tmp-fileinfo-proof-1783603891638.txt",
      "path": "<repo>\\.agents\\tmp-fileinfo-proof-1783603891638.txt",
      "kind": "file",
      "size": 5,
      "mtimeMs": 1783603891639.2993
    }
  }
}
```

- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: both focused test coverage and a real Windows runtime invocation observe basename-only `FileInfo.name` for Windows separated paths.
